ValidationRule.description: AC6 (EHIS-3798): PHOCS BLA cannot be Closed without Closed By. Scoped to the 5 PHOCS record types; ALR and Dairy excluded.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "ConstructionPermitApplication", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Evaluation", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSExemptions", RecordType.DeveloperName = "OperatingPermitApplication", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRecordofSewerageSystem" ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISBLANK(ClosedBy__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Provide Closed By before closing this application
